p: there a man of Belial: Where the ten tribes contended against Judah.
David: As they of Judah say.
of Jesse: He thought by speaking contemptuously of the king, to stir the people farther to sedition, or else by causing Israel to depart, thought that they of Judah would have esteemed him less.
Jordan even to Jerusalem: From Gilgal which was near Jordan.
Amasa: Who was his chief captain in Joab's place, 2Sa 19:13.
lord's servants: Either those who had been under Joab or David's men.
garment that he had put on: Which was his coat, that he used to wear in the wars.
stood by him: He stood by Amasa at Joab's appointment.
Bethmaachah: To the city Abel, which was near Bethmaachah.
battered the wall: That is, he went about to overthrow it.
They were wont to speak in: She shows that the old custom was not to destroy a city before peace was offered, De 20:10,11.
one of them that are peaceable: She speaks in the name of the city.
matter is not so: Hearing his fault, he gave in to reason, and required only he that was instigator of the treason.
chief ruler about David: Either in dignity or familiarity.
